authority_protocol.source: Dr. Fizar Ahmed ESRC Technical Calibration Protocol (2026-09-29)

provenance.source_title: Soil nutrient status at three depths across 57 grid points, Kushtia, Bangladesh (2024)

srdi_kushtia_om_champion.notes: Trained on SRDI Kushtia (171 rows, 57 Sample_IDs) using K_mg_kg = K_cmol_kg * 391 and depth_mid_cm. TN_pct strictly excluded due to circular derivation (TN = 0.0492 * OM + (-0.0065), r=0.9776).

provenance.source_title: Soil nutrient status at three depths across 57 grid points, Kushtia, Bangladesh (2024)

srdi_kushtia_om_baseline_ols.notes: Standardized Linear OLS baseline on SRDI Kushtia (5 physical/mineral features, excluding TN_pct) used as benchmark gate.

provenance.source_title: Soil Fertility Dataset (N, P, K, pH, EC -> OC%)

kaggle_mineral_oc_benchmark.notes: Honest negative/near-zero R2 benchmark on 873 cleaned rows (7 corrupt outliers flagged: pH 0.90/10.05-11.15, OC=24.0%, Zn=42.0/Fe=44.0). Demonstrates that mineral-only N, P, K, pH, EC cannot predict OC/SOM without Temperature, Moisture, and local AEZ calibration.

provenance.source_title: Kellogg Soil Survey Laboratory (KSSL) POX-C dataset

usda_kssl_poxc_with_soc.notes: Separate USDA-NRCS KSSL POX-C (mg C/kg dry soil) model on <2 mm & 2.5 g subset including lab SOC (% = g/kg / 10). Enforces Passive C != Total SOC - POXC.

provenance.source_title: Kellogg Soil Survey Laboratory (KSSL) POX-C dataset

usda_kssl_poxc_without_soc.notes: USDA-NRCS KSSL POX-C (mg C/kg dry soil) baseline without lab SOC (pH, Sand, Silt, Clay, depth_mid_cm) on <2 mm & 2.5 g subset.

kaggle_mineral_only.outlier_criteria: pH < 3.0 or pH > 10.0, OC > 5.0%, Zn > 10.0 mg/kg, Fe > 20.0 mg/kg
